# Khoa_hoc_mang_may_tinh

Trang web khoa hoc mang may tinh (HTML/CSS/JS) gom danh sach bai hoc, noi dung bai hoc, va bai kiem tra.

## Cau truc thu muc

- `index.html`: Trang chu va danh sach bai hoc.
- `lessons/`: Trang bai hoc (lesson.html) va cac file lien quan.
- `data/`: Du lieu noi dung bai hoc va quiz (JS/JSON).
- `tests/`: Trang bai kiem tra.
- `logo.png`: Logo su dung cho giao dien.
- `scripts/`: Script ho tro (neu can).

## Cach mo trang

Mo `index.html` bang trinh duyet va chon bai hoc/kiem tra.

## Deploy (goi y)

Neu muon dua len hosting:

1. Tai toan bo thu muc len server (giu nguyen cau truc).
2. Dat `index.html` o thu muc public (vi du: `public_html/`).
3. Truy cap `https://ten-mien/` de xem trang.

## Ghi chu

Du an la site tinh, khong can backend. Tat ca noi dung bai hoc va quiz nam trong `data/`.
